mapper.sql: id, title, slug, summary, content, cover_image, category_id, user_id, view_count, comment_count, like_count, is_top, is_deleted, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM blog_article WHERE slug = #{slug} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_article SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_article SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM blog_article WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.slug, a.summary, a.content, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.user_id, a.view_count, a.comment_count, a.like_count, a.is_top, a.is_deleted, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, c.name as category_name FROM blog_article a LEFT JOIN blog_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM blog_article WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND is_top = 1 AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) as totalArticles, SUM(view_count) as totalViews, SUM(comment_count) as totalComments FROM blog_article WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1
SELECT FROM blog_article WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_article (title, slug, summary, content, cover_image, category_id, user_id, view_count, comment_count, like_count, is_top, is_deleted, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{slug}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{coverImage}, #{categoryId}, #{userId}, #{viewCount}, #{commentCount}, #{likeCount}, #{isTop}, #{isDeleted}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_article SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM blog_article WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.slug, a.summary, a.content, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.user_id, a.view_count, a.comment_count, a.like_count, a.is_top, a.is_deleted, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, c.name as category_name FROM blog_article a LEFT JOIN blog_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{date} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
